notes.title: Demo of our new game!
notes.content:
🐱 Hellbrella is a fast-paced action roguelike where you play as a Cat in a Raincoat fighting hordes of demons using an umbrella to survive!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44833379/f95ccbb6c717ffc80d06b6bfaa12ab0255cbff8b.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44833379/9b74e9676edae063df5161df8a2753e127608cd4.png"]


❤️ Don't forget to rate the demo. This helps a lot with development and thank you very much for continuing to follow our projects
